title: The Father of Shmuel bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.51b.20), but Hyman says the reading should be “the father of R' Avin.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli attributes a baraita to the father of Shmuel bar Avin.
Hyman proposes the alternative “the father of R′ Avin.”
